__doc__: Edit `groups` to add/remove runs. Each group corresponds to one experimental
condition (a label on the plot); each group's `csv_paths` is the list of
eval_success.csv files from the seeds/replicates of that condition.
Each entry in `csv_paths` is one seed. The entry can be either:
- a list of strings: a RESUME CHAIN (parent first, downstream child last)
The script concatenates them end-to-end and dedupes on (total_steps,
eval_kind, group, task) keeping the LATER segment's value at overlaps.
Optional per-group filters: `cronos_group_filter` (subset of CRONOS groups,
